description: A painted nighttime scene in heavy rain. In the centre, a stone palace facade with an arched balcony framed by red velvet drapes, a warm lit interior behind, and a lectern with microphones on the balcony. A red velvet banner hangs over the balcony rail. Below, a dense crowd holds dark umbrellas and flags, including light-blue-and-white striped Argentine flags and several other flags. Statues stand on the side rooftops, and lamp posts light the square. No visible text.
